children: Stavanger, 31 August 2026: Moreld ASA has been notified that the following primary insider has sold shares in the Company:

Ole Slorer, a board member in Moreld ASA, has sold 60,000 shares. Following the disposal, Mr. Slorer will hold a total of 100,242 shares in the Company, corresponding to 0.06% of the total share capital.
Please see the enclosed form for further details.
This information is subject to the disclosure requirements in article 19 of the Regulation EU 596/2014 (the EU Market Abuse Regulation) and section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
